messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's the order number, and either the name it ships to or the postcode?
I've got an order under that number. Can you confirm the postcode ····last name on it?

Thanks, Nicholas. Nothing has shipped on this one. The B. BS-2 was due to ship September 15, so we're late and nobody wrote to tell you. That's on us, sorry.

Before we cancel anything: I can put the full amount you paid on your account as store credit, yours to use whenever, no waiting on a bank. Want me to do that instead?

Understood. Then the other route before we cancel: swap the BS-2 for something else on the same order.

Two that work for you in the US: the Hammer Miner BC04, 6 TH/s at $239, in stock and shipping within a few days, or the Hammer Miner Thor P2, 10 TH/s at $369, which ships October 3.

Want me to price either of those against your line? I can do the swap here, same order number.
I would like to wait for the BS-2 platform but lease
Handed to the team · BitFortun terahash compensation owed; support cannot issue money.

Good, we'll keep it as is then. I don't have a confirmed dispatch date from the manufacturer yet, so I won't invent one, we're chasing it and you'll hear from us as soon as it's fixed.

One thing in your favour: the BS-2 listing overstated the hashrate when you bought, so you're owed $50 back on this order. It goes to the card you paid with. The team issues that tomorrow from 10am ET and confirms by email.
Before you go, one thing: you came in to cancel and then chose to wait. What changed your mind?
The product seems awesome if it actually ships
Fair. What made you doubt it would ship, the silence from us, or something you read about the BS-2?
That's on us, you shouldn't have had to come here to find out. Would an update with no date in it have been enough, or do you only want to hear from us once there's tracking?
Update that it’s running late would have been nice

Noted, and passed on. Thanks for saying it plainly.

Updates and tracking go to (email hidden), so worth whitelisting us so nothing lands in spam. A copy of this whole chat comes to that address once we're done here.
Thanks, Nicholas. The $50 and the dispatch date are both with the team for the morning. Enjoy the rest of your evening.
